approval: the user's 'go' for making January and July 2025 ranking-like (relayed by the parallel session, 27 September 2026, after v34 = 228.5933)
purpose: Make the development months January and July 2025 ranking-like for the fold side: every fold-side component refitted on the eleven other 2025 months (leave-one-month-out, LOMO), as December's January-November refit already is and as the ranking's twelve-month refits are. This declaration covers the tree side (the two tree tables' leaves) and the v9 side; the 64 context networks are the parallel session's (AWS GPUs). No weight is chosen here; rounds that use the LOMO tables are declared separately.

tree_side.recipe_and_rounds: exactly the leaf's twelve-month refit (tools/run_adsb_learner_dec.py, runs/adsb_v23/<leaf name>/refit): kind, seed, parameters, exclusions, target, extra features from the source learner's seasonal/forward fold records; rounds = median best iteration of the two folds; no early stopping
tree_side.population: the twelve-month refit population (frozen January-November refit rows 1,919,370 + December build 165,677) minus every row whose movement month (MVT time, the validation protocol's assignment clock) is the held month; the tool refuses if a held-month row is in the fit
tree_side.predicted_rows: every departure of the held month; must equal the held month's rows of the leaf's seasonal predictions (344,419 rows over January + July); NaN where the recipe predicts none (NM-residual learners on missing-clock rows), as in the seasonal predictions
tree_side.ensemble_rule: prc2026_december.scoring.leaf_members (flattened leaves with multiplicities) + ensemble_prediction (nanmean), the rule December's values use; rebuilt from the leaves' seasonal predictions it reproduces the stored seasonal tables (max |diff| 2.4e-11 s for ens_v20_bag_q_all, 0.0 for ens_v22_lirf_q)
tree_side.outputs: runs/lomo_dev/learners/<leaf name>/lomo_<month>/{model, predictions.parquet, run.json}; tables runs/lomo_dev/ens/<table>/lomo/predictions.parquet (MVT_ID_mvt, adsb_full) in the seasonal predictions' row order
tree_side.reproduction_check: first: runs/adsb_v15/lgb_clean with --hold-out 2025-12, whose fit is then exactly the January-November refit population; its model and December predictions are compared with runs/adsb_v15/lgb_clean/refit/model.txt and runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_v15__lgb_clean.parquet (identity expected; any difference is reported before the LOMO tables are used)

v9_side.tool: tools/run_v7_lomo.py --fold L01|L07 --output runs/lomo_dev/v7: tools/run_v7_dec.py's frozen twelve-component v7 fit (specs, settings, seed, October-selected counts) with one held month; run_v7_dec.py is not edited (the wrapper adds single-month folds to its FOLDS table and calls its main)
v9_side.v9: for the held month's rows of the seasonal fold frame (scratch/seasonal.parquet): v9 = max(LOMO v7, floor -12) on clock-present rows; missing-clock rows (v6 fallback) and the LIRF fill population keep the seasonal fold v9, exactly as the v24 cross-fit frames do (tools/build_v24_scratch.py) -> runs/lomo_dev/v9/<month>.parquet in the scratch layout
v9_side.caveat: the missing-clock fallback (about 1.5% of rows) and the LIRF fill-population mixture stay seasonal-fold (7 fitting months)
v9_side.residual_stage: not refitted here: the shipped residual stage is already a twelve-month leave-one-month-out (eleven fitting months) trained on cross-fit v9 rows; applying it to the LOMO v9 is the ranking's construction (trained on cross-fit, applied to refit v9)

execution.workers: Azure arcw0, arcw1, arcw3, arcw4, arcw5, arcw6, arcw7 (arcw2 runs option A and is not touched); one job at a time per worker (never two CatBoosts), 16 threads; v7 on arcw0 (the only worker with run_v7_dec.py and its runs)
execution.round_e: per the parallel session: round E's refit12 processes are stopped before the first job on each worker (their chains record FAILED refit12); on arcw4 the chain first waits until both round-E chains have finished their refit step
execution.launcher: tools/launch_lomo_dev.py plan|launch|status|mirror; plan runs/lomo_dev/plan.json (longest-first assignment, about 10.5 h per worker)
execution.smoke: local code-path tests before this declaration (tools/run_adsb_learner_lomo.py --smoke 3000, 20 rounds, outside runs/): lgb_clean (2025-01), adsb_full_nolirf (2025-07), cat_ctr2_x19_s27 (2025-07), cat_lirf_ctr2_nm_s36 (2025-01); no smoke prediction was scored. The v7 wrapper was checked for its fold registration only (a v7 fit needs about 15 GB)

not_in_scope: no score, weight, selection, export or upload
